Robotics

The Michelin for humanoid robots.

A compliant sole for robots that work in the world, not just on the lab floor.

Protect every step. Millions of load cycles reach the joints through the foot. The sole redistributes them before they arrive.

Move more efficiently. Compliant contact wastes less of every step, on flat ground and long before the terrain gets rough.

Model it, don't fight it. Intelligent geometry is hard to simulate, so bench characterization data ships with every sample: the contact layer fits a sim-to-real pipeline instead of breaking it.
